name: Mousugu Natsuyasumi! 2
source: When summer vacation is about to start, people are deciding what to do. Somehow it is decided that you will go biking around Japan. As you are planning the journey, a transfer student arrives and asks where the sex club is. Can you resist the temptation and go on your journey?
